title: How To Claim What the Airline Owes You After a Delay, With AI Writing the Letter, Before You Give a Claims Firm a Third of It
short_version: Your flight was 3+ hours late? You're owed £220–£520 per person under UK261 — and up to 6 years to claim it. AI writes the letter in 20 minutes. Claims firms take a third. You don't need them.
